2608.01763.title: EntailLLM: Verifying LLM-Generated Vulnerability Discovery Paths with Domain Knowledge via Logic Programming
2608.01763.paper_summary: Large language models are increasingly used to reason about software vulnerabilities, but their outputs can silently violate domain knowledge, limiting their reliability in safety-critical settings such as medical devices. Prior work either treats that output as a prediction to be scored or constrains it to walks within a single knowledge graph; neither checks whether reasoning over a binary is consistent with an independent body of domain knowledge. We present EntailLLM, which validates each LLM-proposed analyst path by entailment: the path is a traversal of the binary's function call graph, the domain knowledge is represented in a separate graph, and verification aligns the two under temporal annotated logic. Across three CWE classes, four LLMs, three prompting strategies, and seven binaries varying in size from 405 to 12,696 function call-graph nodes, domain knowledge raises pooled entailment from 78% to 98%, with entailment decreasing in only 3% of the experiments. EntailLLM is deployed end-to-end on real medical-device binaries, reaching 98% pooled entailment without per-device tuning. Our system inherits the formal guarantees of generalized annotated logic, providing logical verification of LLM output that is both explainable and grounded in well-defined semantics.
2608.01763.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型越來越多地用於推理軟體漏洞，但它們的輸出可能會默默違反領域知識，限制了它們在安全關鍵環境（如醫療設備）中的可靠性。先前的研究要麼將該輸出視為需要評分的預測，要麼將其限制在單一知識圖譜內；兩者都沒有檢查對二進位的推理是否與獨立的領域知識體一致。我們提出了EntailLLM，它通過推理驗證每個LLM提出的分析路徑：該路徑是二進位函數調用圖的遍歷，領域知識則在一個單獨的圖中表示，而驗證則在時間標註邏輯下將兩者對齊。在三個CWE類別、四個LLM、三種提示策略和七個大小從405到12,696個函數調用圖節點不等的二進位中，領域知識使得合併推理從78%提高到98%，而只有3%的實驗中推理減少。EntailLLM在真實醫療設備的二進位上端到端部署，達到98%的合併推理，且無需針對每個設備進行調整。我們的系統繼承了廣義標註邏輯的形式保證，提供了對LLM輸出的邏輯驗證，這既可解釋又基於明確定義的語義。
